We are thrilled to expand our collaboration with @GlobalFoundries. In addition to deploying Spot across their global manufacturing network, GF will be the first semiconductor manufacturer to test humanoid robots as part of Atlas early adopter program.

GF has worked with Boston Dynamics and Spot for over four years and recently expanded the program to Singapore, where two Spot robots have traveled nearly 900 kilometers and completed more than 90,000 inspections in sub-fab areas since April, achieving a 99% mission success rate.

https://bosdyn.co/4jmxibq

results.text:
We're thrilled to announce Stretch Gen 2, the next generation of our autonomous mobile trailer unloading robot!

"Our customers count on Stretch to keep freight moving, and every hour a robot sits idle is an hour of work that piles up on the dock. With Gen 2, we focused on the things that actually took robots offline in the real world. We made it tougher, we made it simpler to service, and we made sure it keeps getting better long after it's deployed." - Brian Donnelly, VP & GM - Logistics Robotics

Learn more: https://bosdyn.co/4AdYpLG
